Description: Gran Via Kitchen LLC will operate a mixed-use food facility consisting primarily of a non-public commissary kitchen, storage, refrigeration, receiving, warewashing, administrative and support areas serving Gran Via Group's restaurant and catering operations. A limited customer-facing restaurant component, Ibéxico, will occupy approximately 595 square feet at the front of the premises with approximately 15 seats. Ibéxico will serve food for on-site consumption and beer and wine in connection with an ABC Type 41 license.

Description: Taylor & Thornburg Physical Therapy, Inc., established in 2003 on Oakland, is an outpatient physical therapy practice providing rehabilitation and wellness services to adults and adolescents. The practice provides individualized evaluation and treatment for orthopedic and sports injuries, post-surgical rehabilitation, neurological conditions, balance and vestibular disorders, chronic pain, pelvic health conditions, and other musculoskeletal and movement-related conditions. Patients are seen by appointment and receive one-on-one care from licensed physical therapists. Treatment may include therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, balance and gait training, neuromuscular rehabilitation, patient education, and standard physical therapy treatment modalities and equipment. The premises include a reception and administrative area, private treatment rooms, and open rehabilitation/gym areas. Patient visits generally consist of evaluation, treatment, and supervised therapeutic exercise or movement activities. The practice operates as an outpatient healthcare facility only. There are no inpatient or overnight services, surgical procedures, emergency medical services, or urgent-care services. The practice is a professional healthcare office and does not generate significant noise, odors, vibration, or other impacts outside the premises. Deliveries are limited to normal office and physical therapy supplies. The primary use of the property consists of scheduled patient appointments and the administrative functions associated with the practice.
